# Participant preparation

Participants who want a short MSE refresher before the technical sessions can use the [MSE training resources](SCW17-MSE-training.html) page. The suggested path starts with the IOTC MSE introduction and Shiny app, then uses the FAO Training Adventure as a scenario-based exercise for comparing candidate management procedures.

This orientation material is not a source of SCW17 jack mackerel results or decisions. It is intended to provide common terminology and a low-stakes example before the workshop turns to the SCW17 operating models, candidate management procedures, and performance metrics.

# Design principles

The schedule is built around five guiding principles:

1. **Front-load high-cognition technical work.** OM walk-through and MP setup happen Monday afternoon through Tuesday, while attention is fresh.
2. **Reserve mid-week for results.** Wednesday produces the first integrated MP-evaluation results so Thursday can be spent on trade-offs and shortlisting, not on re-running models.
3. **Use Thursday as the decision day.** The CMP shortlist for SC14 is decided Thursday afternoon, so Friday morning is drafting and assignment, not deliberation.
4. **Breakouts only when they save plenary time.** Each breakout has a named lead, a named output, and a hard return-to-plenary time.
5. **End each day with a 30-minute wrap that names what's needed by 09:00 the next morning.** Avoids dead time at the start of each day.

# Standing items each day

- **08:55 / 08:25 Tue:** Quiet check-in time; chair confirms quorum and any overnight communications.
- **Coffee breaks** are 15 minutes and start on the clock; presenters do not run into the break.
- **Lunch** is 12:00–13:00 (Mon, Wed, Thu) and 12:00–13:00 (Tue, with the 08:00 start that's still a 4-hour morning block — chair will signal a 5-min stretch at 10:00 on top of the formal coffee break if needed).
- **End-of-day 30-min wrap** is non-negotiable, even on the technically heaviest days. The chair will not allow a session to swallow the wrap.
- **Side-room** is reserved each afternoon for small breakouts. Any breakout must register a lead, a return-time, and a one-line output before leaving plenary.

# Risk register and fallbacks

| Risk | Fallback |
|---|---|
| OM conditioning not closed by Tuesday 17:00. | Move OM sign-off to Wednesday 08:30; compress MP register walkthrough to 60 minutes. |
| MP register changes during the workshop. | Not permitted under TG-05 freeze. Late-arriving MPs run as comparison only, do not enter shortlist. |
| Cross-platform validation incomplete. | Treat as SC14-02 paper deliverable rather than blocking shortlist decision. |
| Shortlist deliberation deadlocked at 17:00 Thursday. | Chair invokes the documented fallback (top-three reference-OM CMPs by composite trade-off score). |
| Friday slippage. | Hard close at 12:00. Outstanding drafting items become Task Team action with a 7-day deadline. |
| Remote participation drops out. | Workshop continues in-person; remote items are flagged for catch-up on the post-workshop Task Team call. |

# Post-workshop close-out (for the chair)

- **Within 48 hours:** circulate draft list of agreed decisions to all participants.
- **Within 7 days:** circulate draft minutes; collect corrections within a further 7 days.
- **Within 14 days:** confirm the SC14 paper drafting timeline and check first drafts are on track.
- **TT-06 (Thu 9 July):** post-Wageningen review; CMP shortlist review for SC14 drafting.
